reasons.lighting: No explicit instruction identifies a light source, its direction, or visible quality; the dark-showroom lighting is an observed reference property, not a request, so lighting remains reference-governed.
reasons.framing: No explicit camera framing instruction is given; specifying 16:9 aspect and 8 seconds configures canvas/timing, not camera composition, so framing remains reference-governed.
reasons.palette: No explicit palette instruction is given, so palette remains reference-governed.
